name: Summon Star
body:
School illumination (conjuration) (summoning); Level cleric/oracle 7, sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, F (a sunrod, which is consumed if the star dies)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one summoned creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You summon a star from the heavens to do your bidding.

It appears as a glowing humanoid with long white hair, birdlike talons as well as hands, and it carries a staff made of pure force. All creatures other than you who view the star must make a DC 20 Will save or be fascinated for the duration of the spell. The star is otherwise equivalent to an avoral agathion with 91 hp whose lightning bolt ability deals force damage.
